headline: Sensex and Nifty tumble over 500 points amid profit booking and US Fed rate hike fears

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit booking after a two-day rally
Fears of potential US Federal Reserve rate hikes
India's crude import bill surged 87.5% in October due to West Asia tensions
Heavy selling in metal and consumer durable sectors
whatHappening: BSE Sensex fell by more than 500 points during the session
NSE Nifty 50 dropped below the 25,250 mark
Tata Steel announced plans for hydrogen production using plant off-gases
Government relaxed export guidelines to support MSME exporters
summary: The Indian stock market snapped its two-day rally as the Sensex dropped over 500 points amid profit booking and US Fed rate hike fears. Metal and consumer durable sectors faced significant selling pressure, while Nifty 50 fell below the 25,250 level. Tata Steel remained in focus due to its hydrogen production plans and green transition strategy.
